steps.instruction: Peel and thinly slice 1 3/4 pounds of red potatoes.
Boil the sliced potatoes for 17 minutes.
steps.spoken: Boil the potatoes for about 17 minutes, until they are tender but still somewhat firm.

steps.instruction: Drain the potatoes, set them aside and let them cool.
Cook 1/4 pound of chopped bacon until crisp.
Mix 1 tablespoon of flour into a small amount of bacon grease.
steps.spoken: Keep a small amount of the bacon grease and mix 1 tablespoon of flour into it, breaking up all the clumps.

steps.instruction: Cook the flour mixture briefly without browning it.
steps.spoken: Cook the flour mixture briefly. Try to avoid browning it.

steps.instruction: Add the bacon and 4 tablespoons of vegetable oil.
Add 1 tablespoon of mayonnaise and 5 tablespoons of apple cider vinegar.
Add 2 tablespoons of Riesling wine and 4 tablespoons each of beef stock and chicken stock.
Add 8 tablespoons of chopped red onion and 1 tablespoon of chopped green onions.
Add 1 tablespoon each of sugar and coarse prepared mustard.
Add 1/4 teaspoon each of salt and pepper, then mix.
Cook on low heat for 20 minutes, until smooth.
Pour the sauce over the potatoes and stir gently.
steps.spoken: Pour the sauce over the potatoes and stir gently. Serve warm, room temperature, or cooled.
